correctness.rationale: Disjoint interior-vertex isolation, uniform exterior hypergeometric edge conditioning, and symmetry yield the exact covariance identity. For trees e=s−1, logarithmic ratios converge to 2/alpha; elementary calculus gives the unique nontrivial root. The G(n,p) sign follows independent disjoint edge coordinates. 113 exhaustive finite graph strata and six phase-side checks corroborate, but do not replace, the proof.
